title: Design, synthesis, antiproliferative activity, estrogen receptors binding affinity of C-3 pregnenolone-dihydropyrimidine derivatives for the treatment of breast cancer.
authors: Alyami, Bandar A; Ejaz, Iqra; Mahnashi, Mater H; Alqahtani, Yahya S; Alqarni, Ali O; Saeed Jan, Muhammad; Sadiq, Abdul; Rashid, Umer
one_liner_zh: 该文研究孕烯醇酮-二氢嘧啶衍生物的抗增殖活性及与雌激素受体α的结合亲和力，属于小分子-蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Breast cancer (BCa) is very common malignancy and globally, has become the second leading cause of cancer death among women. For the treatment of BCa, estrogen receptors-alpha (ERalpha) has proven to be a therapeutic target. In continuation of our previous reported dihydropyrimidine-based pregnenolone derivatives, we modified at C-3 hydroxyl group. Structural architecture of estrogen receptors (ER) with excellent ER binding affinity was used for modification. MTT assay was used to evaluate the synthesized steroidal analogs for their antiproliferative activities against ER-positive MCF-7, ER-negative MDA-MB-231 (ER(-)) breast cancer cells and non-cancerous HEK-293 cells. Structure activity relationship (SAR) studies revealed that diethanolamine containing pregnenolone derivatives showed significant cytotoxicity against ER + MCF-7 and also showed good binding affinity with ERalpha and are relatively safe against HEK-293 cell model. Docking studies demonstrated that high binding affinity of diethanolamine analogs is due to their binding interaction with key amino acid residues present in the binding site of Eralpha.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌（BCa）是一种非常常见的恶性肿瘤，在全球范围内已成为女性癌症死亡的第二大原因。对于BCa的治疗，雌激素受体-α（ERalpha）已被证明是一个治疗靶点。在我们先前报道的基于二氢嘧啶的孕烯醇酮衍生物的基础上，我们对C-3羟基进行了修饰。利用具有优异ER结合亲和力的雌激素受体（ER）结构架构进行修饰。采用MTT法评估合成的甾体类似物对ER阳性MCF-7、ER阴性MDA-MB-231（ER(-)）乳腺癌细胞以及非癌性HEK-293细胞的抗增殖活性。构效关系（SAR）研究表明，含二乙醇胺的孕烯醇酮衍生物对ER+ MCF-7表现出显著的细胞毒性，并且与ERalpha具有良好的结合亲和力，同时对HEK-293细胞模型相对安全。对接研究表明，二乙醇胺类似物的高结合亲和力归因于它们与ERalpha结合位点中关键氨基酸残基的结合相互作用。
